title: Word Order and Style
subtitle: More flexible than modern, French-influenced.
objectives: Read and translate authentic Middle English texts.
Prepare for sustained reading in Stage 3.

sections.heading: Content
sections.body: More flexible than modern English. Verb-subject inversion common after adverbs (Thanne longen folk to goon...). French influence: adjective sometimes follows noun (chivalrye royal). The syntax is transitional between Old English (fully inflected, free word order) and modern English (fixed word order).

items.prompt: What is the focus of this lesson?
Can you apply this to reading?
items.answer: Work through examples with your notes.
